channel.description: Recent content in Computer Vision on Yash Thube

item.title: Paper Implementations
item.author: Yash Thube
item.description: PyTorch implementations of research papers, aimed at deepening my understanding of the underlying concepts.

item.title: SSL-Vision
item.author: Yash Thube
item.description: Implementation of four self-supervised learning (SSL) algorithms; SimCLR, MoCo-v2, BYOL, and DINO on the CIFAR-10 dataset using a ResNet-18 backbone. All scripts are designed to run on Google Colab Free Tier (single GPU, ~12 GB RAM) with CIFAR-10.

item.title: Task-Aware Segment Anything with LoRA
item.author: Yash Thube
item.description: A lightweight hypernetwork that generates LoRA adapters for the Segment Anything Model (SAM) based on natural language task descriptions.
